blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) warned against social media posts allegedly inciting violence during rallies. It also ordered an investigation into those behind the content as the country hosts the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “We will not allow the misuse of social media to threaten public safety or undermine the peaceful conduct of the Asean Summit,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Wednesday. “Freedom of expression carries responsibility, and those who use online platforms to incite violence must be held accountable under the law,” PGEN Nartatez said.
